scripts.dev:api: npm run build:engine && npm run start:dev -w @grasp/api
scripts.build: npm run build:engine && npm run build -w @grasp/api && npm run build -w @grasp/app
scripts.lint: oxlint -c .oxlintrc.json --deny-warnings api apps/api/src apps/api/test apps/app/src apps/app/scripts apps/app/public/theme-boot.js libs/engine/src scripts tools e2e
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:engine && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
